trust_decision.summary: Ammonia decides attribute safety only on the attributes physically present on an element (whitelist + URL-scheme in clean_child, attribute_filter/url_relative/style/class in adjust_node_attributes); the attributes of an SVG <animate>/<set> (attributeName, values, from, to) are never interpreted, so a whitelisted animation writes attacker-chosen values into the target element's attribute at render time without ever passing those checks.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says attributeName is not checked; grepping the tree for attributeName returns nothing, so the engineer lands on the one place where an element's attributes are decided (the attr_filter/retain in clean_child) and sees that only the element's own attributes are inspected.

fix_sites.module_kind: sanitizer driver: clean_dom gains a pre-pass that maps every id to its element's tag name (fix.diff:115-130)
sanitizer driver: clean_child and adjust_node_attributes are now called with the parent handle and the id->tag map (fix.diff:141-142)
per-node whitelist and URL-scheme gate: the retain becomes a tag/attr/value closure and animate/set values are passed through it (fix.diff:151-273)
per-node attribute rewriter: animate/set values are routed through attribute_filter, url_relative, style::filter_style_attribute and allowed_classes (fix.diff:277-472)

fix_sites.entry_point: Builder::clean / Builder::clean_from_reader (shared helper, also used by the non-animation path at src/lib.rs:1961 and src/lib.rs:2210)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared classifier: is_url_attr stops treating animate/set's own href as a navigable URL and learns xlink:href for attributeName values (fix.diff:475-487)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: attributeName="style" only matters when the caller whitelisted style and configured filter_style_properties, and src/style.rs is the existing CSS-declaration filter for the plain style attribute - a solver can call CSS value filtering a separate policy concern and leave animated style values alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate animation must survive: a whitelisted animation of a non-URL attribute (e.g. <animate attributeName="y"> on <a> with y whitelisted) stays, animation of a set_tag_attribute_value target is dropped, and the animate element's own href="#id" target reference must not be rewritten or dropped as if it were a navigable URL. An over-broad fix (refuse or strip every animate/set, or make is_url_attr treat animate's href as a navigable URL) breaks all three.

O6_input_shapes: values="a;b;c" semicolon-separated list (each element checked separately)
target taken from the parent element when href is absent
target taken from href="#id" via a document-wide id -> tag-name map (forward references, duplicate ids, unknown ids)
attributeName naming a URL attribute (href, xlink:href, src, form/action, object/data, button|input/formaction, a/ping, video/poster) versus style, class or a plain non-URL attribute
both the <animate> and the <set> element, in the SVG namespace only

O7_producer.where: fix.diff:115-130 (id -> tag-name map built in clean_dom, src/lib.rs:1806)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second document-wide pre-pass (e.g. an id -> namespace or id -> whitelisted-attribute set) consumed by the attribute gate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the 4.1.4 fix already establishes a pre-pass map in clean_dom for exactly this sink, so a maintainer extending href-target resolution would naturally add another map there

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a value-filter route that only runs when style_properties is configured, next to the same animated values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix reuses the plain-style CSS filter for attributeName="style"; the same branch already has a config-dependent None case that a sibling could copy

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a merge/defaults route that writes builder-supplied attribute values after the whitelist and URL checks
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: set_tag_attribute_values already injects attributes post-check, and the fix has to special-case it (an animation of a forced attribute is dropped, fix.diff:251), so a parallel config-injection feature is realistic

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new URL-valued attribute (or a new alias such as xlink:*) added only to the direct-attribute path and not to the animated-value path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: is_url_attr is the single list the fix had to amend twice (exclusion for animate's own href, addition of xlink:href); a maintainer adding a URL attribute would edit this same function

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79): sanitizer does not neutralize values that SVG SMIL <animate>/<set> will write into another element's attribute at render time

O10_build.toolchain: cargo, edition 2021, rust-version 1.80 (Cargo.toml:12-13); deps html5ever 0.39, url 2, cssparser 0.37, maplit 1.0; Cargo.lock.msrv is the only lock file
O10_build.project_tests: cargo test: a large unit-test module in src/lib.rs (mod test, incl. SVG/MathML namespace and annotation-xml tests), plus tests/version-numbers.rs (version-sync). No animate/set tests exist at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Refuse the configuration outright (the 3.3.3/4.0.3 backports literally assert/panic when animate or set is whitelisted, fix.diff:39-40 and fix.diff:1044-1045) or filter only the values= shape against the parent element, which lets from/to, href="#id" targets and set continue to write javascript: URLs.
